capabilities: Syncs Screvi highlights into vault notes
Adds properties blocks to each note
Schedules automatic syncs at set intervals
disambiguation: Despite the name, it only imports highlights from Screvi into Obsidian; it does not push notes back to Screvi.
extras: Auto-sync defaults to on every 2 hours and polls api.screvi.com; no analytics or telemetry. Notes from v1.0.5 and earlier keep the old format until the Screvi folder is deleted and Full sync is run; text typed into those notes in Obsidian is not restored.
problem: Obsidian cannot by itself pull reading highlights collected in Screvi from Kindle, Kobo, Apple Books, Readwise and the web into the vault.

relations.evidence: Sync your Screvi highlights into Obsidian.

summary: Syncs highlights from Screvi (Kindle, Kobo, Apple Books, Readwise, web) into Obsidian as markdown notes organized by source.
